sourceFiles.behavior: Ordered sibling folder reuse, distinct file/folder identities, parents/children and preorder rows; native primitives replace unimported emoji.
Slash paths and note blocks; native rejects empty components, unknown rows and unterminated notes.
Hidden root and sibling-note anchor at last file parent or root after folder-only declaration.
Nearest lower-stage ancestry and activity branch width; native corrects duplicate root paint.
Ordered children, increasing stages and DFS columns; first child keeps parent column, later child follows previous subtree. Native traversal is iterative.
Zero-plus activity roots, positive-stage releases, horizontal activity offsets and full-board dashed stage boundaries.
Plus-count stage and required labels; native rejects orphan releases and substantive unsupported commands.
Nominal150x70 cards; native measured minima expand dimensions for full labels and paint every root once.
Nominal170x90 pitches; measured native card minima plus20-unit gaps preserve stages/columns.

Ordered textual named blocks, single-block unwrapping, duplicate fields, string scalars and quoted-string/object arrays; backslash consumes next character. Native rejects duplicate topblocks, calls/evaluation/interpolation/nested or bare arrays and retains physical line separators.
Whole hash-comment rows omitted and quoted hashes retained. Native preserves physical newline separators instead of concatenating bare tokens.

Config defaults, inclusive field identity, declaration-width placement and row splitting/direction/heights. Native corrects remainder conservation, max-height row clearance and colwidth1 default interval.
Measured label/full rectangle contract. Native expands one common bit scale to retain complete UTF8 labels; no abbreviation/continuation/rotation paint claim.
Numbered/nonnumbered short/full ticks and centered measured indices; original native top-scale geometry.
Inclusive ranges, single-bit len, auto start after last end and requested height. Native complete attributes reject rotate/unknown/duplicate values, descending ranges and len on explicit range.
Positive colwidth1..999 controls actual row wrapping.
Positive node_height1..999 controls vertical unit; native also reserves full measured label height.
Positive scale_interval controls actual tick numbering and is capped at final configured colwidth.
ltr/rtl reverses actual block placement and tick indices.
same_height promotes actual row cells to maximum; native always reserves maximum row clearance.
Canonical packetdiag opener; native admits only one optional balanced canonical braced body.
Closing brace marker; native validates whole balanced block and rejects trailing substantive input.

implementationNotes: Task3I adds four dedicated immutable files/packetdiag/board/HCL models. Files trie/notes use original native symbols; packet conserves inclusive widths under measured common bit scale and max-height row clearance; board preserves nearest-lower ancestry/DFS columns with one root paint; HCL lowers ordered duplicate string fields into real owning-row compartments. HCL duplicate topblocks/style/chrome/calls/evaluation/interpolation/nested or bare arrays reject; physical lines remain separators. No runtime IO/dependencies/assets/later families/API changes.

Task3H adds stable network/server/group identities and sparse per-network interface memberships, measured horizontal buses and one global server box. Dedicated ordered cable lanes, charged sparse crossing sweeps with actual bus gaps, contiguous group columns and label/header reservations replace dense network-by-server grids. Unsupported shapes/hidden networks/links/colors/widths fail explicitly. Canonical balanced body, #RRGGBB fills and full bus width are admitted; whole grammar consumed. Native row/column geometry differs from upstream and is not pixel parity.

Task3F adds a dedicated deterministic day-only Gantt model and measured date axis/bar/diamond scene. ISO dates are explicit and bounded; all seven days are open. Dependency dates are captured in source order with conservative freeze-after-reference admission, not a final reactive DAG. Native sparse calendar ticks and routes differ from upstream geometry; milestone references do not invent drawn arrows. No new runtime IO, ambient dates, dependencies or assets.
Distinct mindmap side-stack/multiplier and WBS global-chain/fork/trunk models. Original measured native tree geometry, no generic mirrored fallback.

Strict ordered duplicate-preserving JSON and narrow preflighted PlantUML YAML string semantics. Data labels remain literal and do not enter UML rich-text/newline normalization. New tree/data labels measure and emit the same explicit Arial/Liberation Sans/DejaVu Sans/Noto Sans/sans-serif chain. EclipseSource minimal-json MIT notice retained.

State owns a distinct typed model and recursive checked Dagre graph adapter. Activity uses structured instructions with bottom-up explicit entry/live/dead exit ports; neither is a UML/sequence AST rewrite.
State-qualified declarations/cross-ownership transitions and activity next-arrow/backward-route syntax remain explicit subset rejections. No concurrency/history/swimlane semantics are claimed.
Typed native ASTs and SVG scenes; no PlantUML-to-Mermaid source rewriting.
Dagre layout from separately audited dugong0.9.2, not PlantUML Graphviz/Smetana/ELK code.
Budgeting, native scene geometry and SVG serialization are original glue. No upstream theme/icon/font assets imported.
Selected MIT artifact files retain legacy upstream comment headers beneath their generated MIT grant. Their bytes/hashes were not cleaned or altered.

Task3D2 adds raw-byte Direct/Expansion origins, immutable eager definitions and compact earlier-definition lineage IDs. Statement errors keep authoritative parser lines and bounded expansion-use context; late Creole errors identify label-local locations and bounded textual candidates (including inert duplicates), not falsely precise authored spans. Existing YAML nested-flow/quote diagnostics remain line1. Columns in known source spans are one-based UTF-8 bytes.

Task3D/3D2 are bounded styles/measured runs/literal preprocessing checkpoints, not full Task6 or PlantUML parity. Only immutable preamble !define is admitted; full TIM and resources remain denied. No dependencies/assets/runtime IO added. Raw family input is preserved before existing grammar admission. Baselines remain font-size/4.5 approximations; fixtures are native validation sources, not geometry oracles.
